info.title: CivicFix API
info.description: Community problem reporting. Every response uses the envelope { success, data } or { success: false, message, code, details? }.

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up (never touches the database).
Readiness: the database answers (503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE otherwise).

post.summary: Create an account and sign in (sets the auth cookies).
Rotate the refresh token cookie and issue a new access token.
Revoke the refresh token and clear the auth cookies.
Change the password; revokes other sessions and issues a new one.
Create a report with 1 to 5 photos (multipart field `images`).

images.description: 1 to 5 photos (PNG, JPEG or WebP), at most 5 MB each.

get.summary: Reports within a radius, nearest first.

post.summary: Possible duplicates near a location in the same category.

patch.summary: Edit a report (owner while SUBMITTED, or an admin).

delete.summary: Delete a report (owner while SUBMITTED, or an admin).

get.summary: Comments on a report, oldest first.

delete.summary: Delete a comment (its author or an admin).

patch.summary: Change status (the state machine decides what each role may do).

post.summary: Mark as a duplicate of another report.

get.summary: Why a report ranks where it does; null when it is closed (not ranked).
Reports assigned to the caller's department.

patch.summary: Update your name, phone or phone visibility.

delete.summary: Disable a category (existing reports keep it).

post.summary: Reset to a one-time temporary password (shown once).

get.summary: Totals and resolution times per department.

requestId.description: On 500s: quote it when reporting the problem.

User.description: The signed-in user (auth and profile endpoints).

internalNote.description: Only present for admins and department staff (BR-012).

counts.description: Present on report detail and list endpoints.

viewer.description: Your own votes and follow; on report detail when signed in.

distanceM.description: Distance in metres; present on nearby and duplicate searches.

MapMarker.description: Lightweight report marker for the map viewport.

AdminUser.description: A user as listed and managed by admins.
